setup.title: Welcome — let's set up your vault
setup.desc: This one-time setup secures your vault and creates the first admin.
setup.passphraseHint: Protects the encryption key. You'll enter it to unlock the vault after a restart. Keep it safe — it can't be recovered.
setup.passphraseShort: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
setup.passwordShort: Password must be at least 12 characters.

celebrate.title: Turn off annoying easter egg?
celebrate.desc: You can partially or fully turn off the easter egg.

firstAdmin.title: Create the first admin
firstAdmin.desc: The vault is unlocked but has no admin yet. Create the first admin account to sign in. This option disappears once an admin exists.

unlock.title: Unlock vault
unlock.desc: Enter the vault passphrase to unlock the encrypted data.

update.started: Update started — the app will restart.
update.startedMac: Downloaded — opening the installer. Quit from the menu bar, drag the new app to Applications, then reopen.
update.backupFailed: The backup failed, so the update was not started. {{error}}
update.confirmText: The app will download and verify the update, then restart to install it.
update.confirmTextMac: The app will download and verify the update, then open the installer. Quit it from the menu bar, drag the new app to Applications, and reopen.

qr.title: Scan 2FA QR code
qr.hint: Point your camera at the QR code shown by the service.
qr.insecure: The camera needs a secure connection (HTTPS) or localhost.
qr.denied: Camera permission was denied. Allow it in your browser and try again.
qr.noCamera: No camera was found on this device.
qr.notTotp: That QR code isn't a 2FA setup code.

login.title: Account Manager
login.mfaHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.mfaBackupHint: Lost your device? Enter a backup code instead.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.desc: Protect your login with a time-based code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, and others).
totp.scanHint: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app:
totp.disableTitle: Enter a code to disable two-factor
totp.backupHint: Store these somewhere safe. Each code works once, and they're your only way in if you lose your authenticator. They won't be shown again.

pw.breach: ⚠ Found in {{count, number}} known breaches — choose another.

audit.title: Logs
audit.desc: A record of security-relevant actions: who did what, from where, and when.

deploy.title: Deployment
deploy.intro: Controls how the server listens. The app only listens on a host and port — a reverse proxy in front maps your domain and handles HTTPS.
deploy.portHint: The port the app listens on (default 8080), e.g. http://localhost:8080.
deploy.networkHint: Localhost keeps it private to this machine. “Accessible on the network” lets other machines (and your mapped domain) reach it.
deploy.publicUrlHint: The address the app is served at, e.g. https://accounts.example.com. Used so links come out correct; leave blank for localhost.
deploy.restartNote: Changes apply after you restart the app.
deploy.savedRestart: Saved — restart the app to apply
deploy.portInvalid: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.

authenticator.title: Authenticator
authenticator.desc: Live 2FA codes for saved services that have a stored setup key. Click a code to copy it.
authenticator.empty: No accounts have a stored 2FA secret yet. Add one on an account's page (One-time password).

accountTotp.title: One-time password (2FA)
accountTotp.desc: If this service has two-factor enabled, add its setup key here to generate the codes in-app.
accountTotp.removeText: The stored 2FA secret for this account will be deleted.

history.title: Password History
history.desc: Previously used passwords for this account, newest first. Click to reveal.

breach.title: Breach monitoring
breach.desc: Automatically check stored passwords against the Have I Been Pwned breach corpus on a schedule. Only a short hash prefix is sent — passwords never leave the server.

email.title: Email
email.loadFailed: Couldn't load the email settings. If you just updated the app, restart it so the server is up to date.
email.offHint: Email is off. Turn it on (top right) to set it up. Your saved settings are kept while it is off.
email.desc: Connect an email account so the app can send reports and reminders. Works with any SMTP provider.
email.passwordKeep: A password is saved. Leave blank to keep it.

report.title: Send Emails
report.monthlyDesc: Last month's payments as an Excel file, on the 1st of each month.
report.reminderDesc: Emails you in the days before a payment is due. Choose the days with the pencil.
report.reminderNothing: Nothing is due in the next 7 days, so there's nothing to send.
report.rotationDesc: Emails you in the days before a password is due for rotation. Choose the days with the pencil.
report.rotationNothing: No passwords are due for rotation in the next 7 days, so there's nothing to send.
report.daysTitle: How often do you want reminders?
report.daysHint: You get one email on each day you tick, counting down to the due date.
report.breachDesc: An email right away when a breach scan finds a password in a new data breach (not on a schedule).
report.breachNothing: No passwords are currently flagged as breached, so there's nothing to send.
report.upcomingDesc: The month's upcoming payments and their total, on the 1st of each month.
report.upcomingNothing: No payments are scheduled this month, so there's nothing to send.

config.title: Configuration
config.clipboardHint: Wipe a copied password from the clipboard after this many seconds. 0 disables auto-clear.
config.currenciesHint: USD is the base. Activate others to convert values — rates refresh daily.
config.languagesHint: Activate Arabic to show the language switcher and right-to-left layout for those who want it.
config.languagesFields: Adds an optional Arabic-name field to categories, users, and admins.
config.turnOffText: The language switcher and right-to-left layout will be hidden. Arabic data you entered is kept unless you choose to delete it.
config.purgeLabel: Also permanently delete all Arabic data (categories, seats, admins)

backup.title: Backups
backup.hint: Scheduled full backups of the database (attachments included). Keep the MASTER_KEY somewhere separate — backups stay encrypted and can't be restored without it.
backup.restoreText: This replaces ALL current data with this backup, and signs everyone out. This cannot be undone.
backup.deleteText: The backup file will be permanently removed.

categories.title: Categories
categories.deleteText: Only empty categories can be deleted. Accounts must be moved out first.

admin.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 12 characters
admin.orgTooLarge: Image is too large (max 5 MB). Please choose a smaller one.
admin.deleteAdminText: They will lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.
admin.passwordTooShortAdd: Password must be at least 12 characters

users.title: Users
users.importHintAr: Column A: name · Column B: Arabic name
users.deleteText: This removes the person from the list and empties any seats holding their name.
users.bulkText: This removes them from the list and empties any seats holding their names.
users.noNamesFound: No names found in the first column.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.seatPick: Seat {{n}} — pick or type a user
accounts.deactivateText: It stays saved for possible reactivation, but is marked inactive.
accounts.deleteText: This permanently deletes the account and its attachments. This cannot be undone.

payments.title: Payment History
payments.deleteText: This permanently removes the payment record. This cannot be undone.

health.title: Vault Health
health.emptyHint: Scan the vault to check for weak and reused passwords.
health.analyzedNotePre: Analyzed in your browser after decryption. Breach checks use
health.analyzedNotePost: via k-anonymity — only the first 5 characters of each password's SHA-1 hash are sent, never the password itself.

errors.usd_base_immutable: USD is the base currency and can't be changed
errors.category_exists: A category with that name already exists
errors.extend_unavailable: This account has no payment date or billing period to extend
errors.smtp_port_invalid: The SMTP port must be between 1 and 65535
errors.smtp_from_invalid: That 'send from' address isn't a valid email address
errors.smtp_credentials_invalid: The username or password contains invalid characters
errors.smtp_insecure: A username and password can't be sent without encryption. Choose SSL/TLS or STARTTLS.
errors.smtp_password_required: Enter a password for that username
errors.email_not_configured: Email isn't set up yet. Configure it in Settings → Email.
errors.email_disabled: Email is turned off. Turn it on in Settings → Email.
errors.account_must_be_inactive: The account must be inactive before it can be deleted
errors.admin_exists: An admin with that email already exists
errors.billing_invalid: Billing period must be 0 or greater
errors.category_in_use: Cannot delete a category that still has accounts; move or remove them first
errors.last_admin: You can't delete the last admin
errors.email_and_password_required: Email is required and password must be at least 12 characters
errors.file_invalid: File too large or invalid form
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.totp_secret_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid 2FA setup key
errors.token_invalid: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.length_invalid: Length must be a number between 1 and 128
errors.new_password_short: New password must be at least 12 characters
errors.next_payment_invalid: Next payment date must be YYYY-MM-DD
errors.registration_closed: Registration is closed; ask an existing admin to invite you
errors.status_invalid: Status must be active or inactive
errors.email_in_use: That email is already in use
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.noFiles: No files. Upload an invoice or document (max 10 MB).
attachments.deleteText: This permanently deletes the attachment and cannot be undone.

export.title: Export backup
export.text: Exports all account data to Excel — one sheet per category.
